caseName: Banco Nacional de Cuba v. Sabbatino
caseNameFull: Banco Nacional de Cuba v. Sabbatino, Receiver
attorneys: John A. Wilson on the motion. Victor Rabinowitz for petitioner in opposition to the motion.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 372 U. S. 905, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. The motion of Compania Azucarera Vertientes-Camaguey de Cuba for leave to file briefs in support of the motion to substitute and on the merits and for leave to participate in oral argument on the merits is granted.
